title: 第5章 谋划第6章 交谈选择
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
夜渐渐深了，星子点点亮起。
石罐咕咚咕咚的响着，袅袅鲜香钻入鼻中，张松舔了舔嘴唇，“差不多了吧？”
“好了。”顾安耸动鼻翼，也感觉饥肠辘辘。
石罐端来，竹筒上桌，二人沿桌坐下。
打开石罐，辛香裹着鲜香扑面，汤色奶白，劈开竹筒，灵鸡焦香四溢。
张松取出竹果酒，竹节酒瓮倾斜，淡青色的酒液如一春雨，滴入陶碗中，酒柱撞击碗底，细密的气泡攀缘而上，清甜的味道也随之升腾。
酒液在杯中渐次舒展——底层沉淀着残存的果肉，中层是清冽的酒水，上层浮着新竹的翡翠光晕，虽浑浊，却灵气四溢。
顾安嗅着酒香，不太确定，“这是灵酒吧？你爷没给你拿错？别是你自个偷拿的。”
“当然不是，这可是一阶下品的竹果酒，我敢拿腿都被打断！”张松咧着嘴笑道。
顾安心中有所猜测，这一筒酒怕是要五、六块灵石，张松爷爷也不可能这么大方，毕竟他也不止一个孙子，自己也要修炼，这怕是最后一次支持？
张松看顾安眼神闪烁，知道他大约猜到了，也并不难猜，之前他就说过这方面的事！
于是故意炫耀道：“我爷这次还给了我一件法器，一阶中品的离火剑，还另给了三十块灵石，哥们也是富裕起来了。”
顾安听完摇了摇头，也是，再怎么说，起点也比自己好太多了，何必多心。
不过转念又想到【灵源回馈】，心情又好了起来。
“来，喝酒。”张松看顾安神情变换，以为是被刺激到了，举起陶碗。
“来。”顾安也举起碗来。
酒液入口，清冽甘甜，中段泛起果香，又似乎夹带着丝丝缕缕的竹香，尾韵带着蜂蜜的温润，仿佛置身雨后竹林，清灵明净。
随即一股微弱的灵气涌起，竟对修为略有进益。
酒至半酣，两人聊的起兴，畅谈起未来。
“我打算加入猎妖队，跟着队伍接些猎妖，寻灵药的任务，这样灵石来的快些。”

“不是我跟你吹，就我这法体双修，又有离火剑在手，在各个猎妖队也是香饽饽，小小妖兽，手到擒来。”
“到时候，灵石赚到手软，我直接就一举筑基，成为筑基长老。”
“然后得到真人赏识，非要支持我结金丹，而我也非常幸运的一次成功，到时候，我就是金丹真人。”
“等我成了金丹真人，这青元宗你直接平趟。”
顾安听着张松牛皮吹的震天响，也不扫兴，笑眯眯地举起酒碗。
“来，敬未来的金丹真人。”
说着，仰头一饮而尽。
该说不说，张松虽然是吹牛，可加入猎妖队未尝不是个好选择。
猎妖队虽然危险，可灵石来的快，机缘多，青元山脉是云雾山脉的支脉，物产丰富，靠山吃山，也算稳妥！
也只有这样，张松筑基的机会才不会那么渺茫！
顾安又喝了口酒，感觉有点上头，面色坨红，开口道：“我斗法能力一般，想去找个宗门的产业去看守。最好是个灵兽养殖的产业，毕竟养了三年的彩羽鸡也算有心得。”
“那简单，半月后我爷庶务堂轮值，到时你去看看，里面的门道他都清楚。”
“行，那我就不客气了，到时去厚颜拜访。”
content_en:
The night is getting deeper and the stars are lighting up.
The stone jar made a buzzing sound, and the fresh fragrance penetrated into his nose. Zhang Song licked his lips, "Is it almost done?"
"Okay." Gu An wiggled his nose, feeling hungry.
The stone jar was brought, the bamboo tube was placed on the table, and the two of them sat down along the table.
When you open the stone jar, you will be greeted by the spicy aroma and the soup is milky white. When you split the bamboo tube, the aroma of burnt chicken overflows.
Zhang Song took out the bamboo fruit wine, tilted the bamboo wine vat, and the light green wine dripped into the pottery bowl like a spring rain. The wine column hit the bottom of the bowl, and fine bubbles climbed up, and the sweet taste also rose.
The wine gradually spreads in the cup - the remaining pulp is deposited on the bottom layer, the clear wine is in the middle layer, and the emerald halo of Hsinchu floats on the upper layer. Although it is turbid, it is full of aura.
Gu An smelled the aroma of the wine and was not sure, "Is this a spirit bar? Did your father bring you the wrong one? Don't steal it yourself."
"Of course not, this is the first-grade low-grade bamboo fruit wine. My legs would be broken even if I dared to try it!" Zhang Song said with a grin.
Gu An had a guess in his mind. This bottle of wine would probably cost five or six spirit stones. Grandpa Zhang Song couldn't be so generous. After all, he had more than one grandson and he also wanted to practice. Is this the last time he would support him?
Zhang Song looked at Gu An with twinkling eyes and knew that he had probably guessed it, and it was not difficult to guess. He had said this before!
So he deliberately showed off: "My father also gave me a magical weapon this time, a first-level mid-grade Lihuo sword, and another thirty spiritual stones. My brother has also become rich."
Gu An shook his head after hearing this. No matter what, the starting point was much better than his own, so why bother.
But then I thought of [Lingyuan Feedback], and my mood improved again.
"Come, let's drink." Zhang Song saw Gu An's expression change and thought he was stimulated, so he raised the pottery bowl.
"Come on." Gu An also raised the bowl.
The wine is refreshing and sweet in the mouth, with a fruity aroma in the middle, and seemingly wisps of bamboo aroma. The finish is warm and honey-like, as if you are in a bamboo forest after the rain, clean and clear.
Then a weak spiritual energy surged up, which actually slightly improved his cultivation.
After drinking half full, the two of them started chatting happily and talked freely about the future.
"I plan to join the demon hunting team and follow the team to take on some missions of hunting demons and finding spiritual elixirs, so that the spiritual stones will come faster."
"I'm not bragging to you. I am a dual practitioner of magic and body, and I have the Lihuo Sword in my hand. I am also a favorite among all the demon hunting teams. I can capture even the smallest monsters at my fingertips."
"When the time comes, when the spirit stones are earned, I will build the foundation in one fell swoop and become a foundation-building elder."
"Then I was appreciated by the real person and insisted on supporting me to form the golden elixir. And I was very lucky to succeed. By then, I will be the golden elixir master."
"When I become Jindan Zhenren, you can go straight to Qingyuan Sect."
Gu An was not disappointed when he heard Zhang Song's cowhide blowing, and he raised his wine bowl with a smile.
"Come and pay homage to the future Master Jin Dan."
As he spoke, he raised his head and drank it all in one gulp.
Needless to say, although Zhang Song was bragging, joining the demon hunting team might not be a bad choice.
Although the demon hunting team is dangerous, the spirit stones come quickly and there are many opportunities. The Qingyuan Mountains are a branch of the Yunwu Mountains and are rich in products. It is safe to rely on the mountains to support them!
Only in this way will Zhang Song's chances of building a foundation won't be so slim!
Gu An took another sip of wine and felt a little high. His face turned red and he said, "My fighting ability is average, so I want to find a sect property to guard. It would be best to have a spiritual animal breeding industry. After all, I have gained experience in raising colorful feather chickens for three years."
"That's simple. My father will be on duty at the General Affairs Hall in half a month. Then you can go and take a look. He knows all the secrets inside."
"Okay, then I won't be polite. I'll pay you a visit then."
